name: Rosa Estaràs Ferragut - § 77/2
title: REPORT on the EU strategy for the rights of persons with disabilities post-2024
part_text: ‘acknowledges that persons with disabilities face significantly higher rates of mental distress compared to persons without disabilities; calls on the Commission to systematically take this into account in the forthcoming EU strategy for the rights of persons with disabilities and to mainstream mental health support across all relevant policies and programmes;’
